rationale: Sensitivity/secondary design for the paper's Extended Data volcanos (high vs 'medium' and low vs 'medium' bins); see design.json for the shared mapping. Genome-wide HD CRISPR library A screen in RKO cells expressing the Kinprola PKA-activity recorder, labeled and sorted into high, basal and low recorder-signal bins in two independent screens (R2, R3), plus a day-0 library per screen. Each sample was sequenced on four lanes (one GSM each); prepare.R sums the lanes (technical re-reads, r = 0.98) and drops the unassigned columns. Knockouts that raise PKA activity are enriched in the high bin, those that lower it in the low bin, each against the basal bin. All three bins of both screens are fitted together (~ bin, residual df 3). Bins correlate more across screens (high-high 0.95, low-low 0.95) than with other bins of the same screen (0.91-0.94), so there is no screen term. 159 NONTARG guides are the controls (the CONTROL_C_* cutting controls are not used as controls). Gene IDs are Ensembl.
